set.body:
Build the common measurement-and-projection contract through which DL1-DL6 and the graph slices expose results. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md, section "Measurement and projection contract" (branch claude/plan-measurement-contract-20261116 @eaea4c207 until merged).
Carry the semantics already decided for the probabilistic path (align temporal queries and TemporalExposure, MeasureKind, ADR 0019 2026-10-11 extension, ADR 0022) to the categorical and detail bundle; reuse features tracks and the recall-onset export. New: joint and broad reference as recorded meanings; measurements on recall units, atoms and source rows; a level-holding allocation. No new public vocabulary before the ADR (bd-01M7J5Q5A9GXDK69JMZ2Q0FP7E) is decided.
Acceptance (engineering, synthetic artifacts, no model call): from the same saved source, recall and mapping artifacts produce (1) a recall-indexed feature table, with a recall-time matrix where timing and projection assumptions permit; (2) a sparse recall-source correspondence table preserving single, joint and broad references, alternative hypotheses, and external, unresolved and processing outcomes; (3) a source-indexed participant summary with explicit coverage definitions, denominators and assessment status. Every output identifies its inputs and derivation policy; unsupported measurements stay explicitly unavailable.
Discriminating controls (independently calculated): A-and-B vs A-or-B; broad summary vs explicit recall of each constituent; one atom spanning several words vs several atoms; unresolved vs external vs not assessed; onset-only vs duration-supported timing; amount-conserving vs level-holding allocation.
Refusing controls: unavailable is never zero; a vector view of a joint or broad reference is refused; non-additive references are not summed; no projection crosses an unestablished clock link; a clause-level vector is not emitted as word-level estimates; no row is dropped by an undeclared threshold.
Worked examples: one synthetic design table each for reinstatement, subsequent-memory and recall-period encoding analyses, built from the three outputs plus named external inputs (source-unit timing, encoding-volume membership).
Not in scope: scientific qualification of any measure; the views on real DL1/DL3/DL4 artifacts (open owner decision 5 in the plan); HRF or FIR modelling beyond a documented downstream recipe; source-content and recall-relation views (deferred to DL2/graph slices and DL5/recall graph).
Slice into day-sized beads when work starts.
